card.name: Linking words before diuretic names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as", "of" and "with" that come right before a named diuretic (loop, thiazide, furosemide). Found in drug-interaction text about diuretics.

modes.label: such as + diuretic type
modes.description: The word "as" in "(such as loop or thiazide diuretics" after non-potassium-sparing diuretics.
modes.example: non-potassium sparing diuretics (such<< as>> loop or thiazide diuretics

modes.label: dose of / given with a diuretic
modes.description: "of" or "with" just before an oral diuretic or a named diuretic drug.
modes.example: a patient who is on maintenance dosage<< of>> an oral diuretic may require additional

card.writes: It seems to push toward water-related words such as irrigation, which looks like a side effect rather than a useful output for these contexts.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a diuretic is named in an interaction list.
